p: Doncaster became a city in 2022, and it has plenty to be proud of. The Frenchgate Shopping Centre sits right beside the railway station, so if you're arriving by train from Leeds, York, Sheffield or London, you can be bouncing within minutes.

Railway fans will love this: the famous locomotives Flying Scotsman and Mallard were both built in Doncaster at the town's railway works. Mallard still holds the world speed record for a steam locomotive, set back in 1938. That's a fact worth sharing with any train-mad kids.
Doncaster Racecourse is home to the St Leger, one of the great classic flat races, and race days bring a big crowd and a real buzz to the town in September.
In the town centre, Danum Gallery, Library and Museum brings together local history, art and collections in one modern building, and Doncaster Market is a lively spot for food and stalls.

Out of town, Conisbrough Castle has a dramatic stone keep that kids can climb for great views, and it's linked with the legend of Ivanhoe. Potteric Carr Nature Reserve, on the southern edge of the city, is a huge wetland where you can spot birds from hides and walk the trails.
With good motorway links and a central station, Doncaster is an easy place to get to and a handy base for exploring more of South Yorkshire.
Shoppers will also find plenty of choice in the Frenchgate itself, so if part of the group fancies a browse while the others bounce, everybody wins.
